items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I saw him one day, and we worked together a long time, we knew each other well. Patrick, you need publicity for your, I was president of the Floral Trail. You need publicity for your Floral Trail, we gotta get newspaper publicity. And I need publicity for my library.

ctx.x: You'd hit a certain note on the Wagner phone... And everything would explode. You know the old glass... Vibrations. The Wagner phone was gonna do it. Without a doubt... He finally, after he gave up music... He became a professor down at one of the high schools down there. The one that was... I think it was Nichols. ! Where they had the Confederate flag. I mean, they had a lot of trouble down there with the Confederate flag. And, uh... Because the colored people didn't like the Confederate flag. So he left the…
